newsitem.title: POLAND: Stalexport mulls $50 mln convertible bonds.
newsitem.headline: Stalexport mulls $50 mln convertible bonds.

text.p: The supervisory board of the Polish steel trader Stalexport will consider a $50 million convertible bond issue at its next meeting on Wednesday, the Parkiet daily said on Saturday.
It said, without quoting any sources, that if the issue was approved it was likely to take place in February next year and likely be placed abroad.

Stalexport now has 8,833,826 shares. Its main shareholders are the treasury with a 25 percent stake, the Merkury Investment Association with a 10.65 percent stake and Creditanstalt Bankverein with 5.55 percent.-- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
